## Basic Information

```{r}
#| label: setup-basic-info
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/basic_info/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
source(here::here("core/R/benchmark-helper.R"))

# Population data source — change this if using a different task for population
pop_task <- "worldpop"
pop_longitude <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_pop_benchmark.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) tibble(Year = integer(), Population = numeric(),
                             Location = character(), Country = character(),
                             Group = character(), Area_km = numeric(),
                             Source = character(), Method = character()))
```

### User Input Variables

```{r}
#| label: setting-title
#| results: asis

print_text(paste("scan-ID", paste_bold(scan_id), ' | GCS: ', paste_bold(USE_GCS)), 2)

print_text(paste("City:", paste_bold(city)), 1)
print_text(paste("Country:", paste_bold(country)), 1)
if (length(bm_cities_manual) == 0) {
  print_text(paste("Manual benchmark cities:", paste_bold("None defined - using automatic detection from nearby countries")), 1)
} else {
  print_text(paste("Manual benchmark cities:", paste_bold(paste_and(bm_cities_manual))), 1)
}
```

### Area and Climate Zone

```{r}
#| label: koeppen-classification
#| results: asis

aoi <- aoi %>% st_as_sf() %>% st_make_valid()
area <- units::set_units(st_area(st_combine(aoi)), km^2)
print_text(paste("AOI Area:", paste_bold(round(area, 1)), "sq km"), 1)

coords <- st_centroid(aoi) %>% st_coordinates() %>% suppressWarnings()
names(coords) <- c("Lon", "Lat")
koeppen_city <- tryCatch({
  koeppen <- read_csv(koeppen_file, col_types = "ddc")
  subset(koeppen, between(Lon, coords["Lon"] - .5, coords["Lon"] + .5) &
                    between(Lat, coords["Lat"] - .5, coords["Lat"] + .5)) %>%
    .$Cls %>% unique()
}, error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(koeppen_city)) {
  print_text(paste("Köppen climate classification:", paste_bold(koeppen_city), "(See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Köppen_climate_classification for classes)"), 1)
}

# Population estimate — use G2 CSV (closest to current year), fallback to raster
pop_estimate <- tryCatch({
  wpop_csv <- fuzzy_read(tabular_dir, "worldpop_2015_2030.csv", read_csv)
  current_year <- as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
  wpop_csv %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(str_extract(year, "\\d{4}"))) %>%
    slice_min(abs(year - current_year), n = 1)
}, error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(pop_estimate) && nrow(pop_estimate) > 0) {
  pop_year <- pop_estimate$year[1]
  pop_val <- round(pop_estimate$population[1])
  print_text(paste("Population estimate:", paste_bold(scales::comma(pop_val)),
    paste0("(WorldPop Global 2, ", pop_year, ")")), 1)
}
```

### Benchmark Cities
Benchmark cities are selected as cities that are in neighboring countries and having a population of 50% to 150% of the focus city's population, with addtional cities manually specified.

```{r}
#| label: benchmark-cities-selection
#| results: asis

print_text("Benchmark cities")

pop_longitude %>%
    subset(Location %in% bm_cities) %>%
    group_by(Location) %>%
    slice_min(abs(Year - 2021), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Location) %>%
    print_paged_df()

if (exists("oxford_full") && nrow(oxford_full) > 0) {
  print_text("Nearby non-benchmark cities")
  oxford_full %>%
    select(Location, Country, Indicator, `2021`) %>%
    subset(Location %in% nearby_cities & Location %ni% bm_cities & Indicator == "Total population") %>%
    mutate(`2021` = `2021` * 1000) %>%
    arrange(`2021`) %>%
    print_paged_df()

  oxford <- subset(oxford_full, Location %in% c(city, bm_cities)) %>%
    mutate(Group = case_when(Location == city ~ Location, T ~ "Benchmark") %>%
             factor(levels = c(city, "Benchmark")))

  print_text(paste_bold("Benchmark footnote text:"))

  print_text("Following cities are included in Oxford Economics dataset:", 1)
  oxford %>%
    select(Location, Country) %>% distinct() %>%
    arrange(Country) %>% group_by(Country) %>%
    summarize(text = paste_and(Location), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(text = paste0(text, " (", Country,")")) %>%
    .$text %>% paste_and() %>%
    paste_bold() %>%
    print_text()
}
```
